segment_exposures.note: Decaying to ~70% by 2029 as custom ASICs scale

thesis.short: NVIDIA captures ~$241B of theoretical 2026 flow across GPUs (~80% share) and Spectrum-X networking. Trades at 40x because the durability story is well-understood, but the segment growth keeps surprising upward.

Override to Watching until the regulatory path clarifies and Calpine integration produces a clean organic baseline.
